title: Cozy House Minutes from Downtown, Broadway, More
description:
Named after the beautiful hydrangeas that frame the home, The Oak Leaf is a charming 3-bedroom cottage built in 1935. Full of character and warmth, the home offers a comfortable place to stay while exploring Nashville. Conveniently located just 4 miles from downtown and 7 miles from the airport, it’s an easy home base for concerts, restaurants, and everything Music City has to offer.

The space
This 1935 home carries a lived-in charm, full of character you won’t find in something new. With a few cracks and quirks that tell its story, the space remains cozy, welcoming, and thoughtfully designed. Whether you’re here for work, play, or a bit of both, we’re delighted to share our  home with you.

Guest access
The entire home is yours during your stay.

Other things to note
A Note About Pricing: Airbnb recently changed how they collect their service fee. Rather than charging guests a separate Airbnb fee during checkout, Airbnb now collects a 15.5% service fee from hosts. As a result, you'll notice that fee is reflected in our nightly rate instead of appearing as a separate charge.
